description: Baseline real-LLM Playwright E2E benchmark for Pokédex template generating 3 websites

asi.hypothesis: Establish a baseline for the real /api/generate Pokédex 3-site workflow with mocks removed so future autoresearch iterations optimize against actual LLM latency.
asi.baseline_notes: Run made exactly 3 /api/generate POSTs; total click-to-render time was 13.13s, API wall time 12.174s, slowest API call 12.174s.
asi.browser_warnings: Two Tailwind CDN production warnings came from generated iframe HTML; not benchmark harness failures.

description: Lower Portkey max_tokens from 4096 to 3072 for generation calls

asi.hypothesis: Generated Pokédex HTML should fit comfortably below 3072 tokens; lowering max_tokens reduces reserved/actual decode budget without changing the prompt, generation count, provider order, or mocking real calls.
asi.result: Primary improved from 13130ms to 11160ms; API wall improved from 12174ms to 10088ms; exactly 3 generation API calls.
asi.quality_risk: Potential truncation on unusually long prompts/apps; no truncation detected by current E2E render gate, but future iterations should avoid lowering too aggressively without adding output-completeness checks.

description: Switch primary Cerebras model from gpt-oss-120b to qwen-3-32b

asi.hypothesis: A smaller but still capable Cerebras-hosted model (qwen-3-32b) should reduce real LLM latency for generated HTML while preserving the same prompt, generation count, provider fallback behavior, and output pathway.
asi.result: Primary improved from prior best 11160ms to 10332ms; API wall improved from 10088ms to 9447ms; exactly 3 /api/generate calls.
asi.quality_risk: Model downgrade may affect generated app quality versus gpt-oss-120b; current E2E confirms render completion only, so future work should add non-cheating quality/completeness monitors before moving to much smaller models.

description: Shorten new-app generation prompt to concise requirements

asi.hypothesis: The old create prompt spent tokens on broad edge-case guidance, comments, and formatting details that increase input/output token work; a concise but general single-file-app prompt should reduce real LLM latency without changing the benchmark prompt, generation count, provider order, or using mocks.
asi.result: Primary improved from prior best 10332ms to 9562ms; API wall improved from 9447ms to 8086ms; exactly 3 /api/generate calls.
asi.quality_risk: Shorter prompt may reduce code structure/comment richness and broad non-Pokedex behavior; still preserves complete HTML, responsiveness, iframe usability, framework imports, inline CSS/JS, and interactive controls.
